+#

+def analyse(suite, vrows, mans, args, cuts, components, v):
+    """Every figure of one suite_version (the rows of no other version enter)."""
+    seed = args.seed
+    main = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False)
+    sens = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True)
+    decisions = [main.arm_report(a, cuts, seed) for a in components]
+    sens_rows = [sens.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components]
+
+    H = h1a4(main, v, seed)
+    h1_state, a4_state = H["h1_state"], H["a4_state"]
+    sens_h = h1a4(Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True, include_degraded=True), v, seed)
+    decidable = any(d["decidable"] for d in decisions) or h1_state in H1_DECIDED or a4_state in A4_DECIDED
+    caps = [c["valid"] for (_, _), trials in sorted(main.cells.items()) for _, c in sorted(trials.items())
+            if c["valid"] is not None and c["valid"]["status"] == "cap_failure"]
+    batches = sorted({r["batch"] for r in vrows})
+    shas = sorted({str(mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for b in batches
+                   if b in mans and mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")}
+                  | {str(r.get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for r in vrows if r.get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")})
+    return dict(H, rows=vrows, main=main, sens=sens, decisions=decisions, sens_rows=sens_rows,
+                decidable=decidable, caps=caps, batches=batches, shas=shas, sens_h=sens_h,
+                budget=budget_matched(main, v))
+

+def render_decisions(L, V, absent, rules):
+    main = V["main"]
+    L("| component | arm | n pairs | pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI] (defects) | cost Δ % | "
+      "wall-clock Δ % | excluded share | decision | rule matched | rows |")
+    L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
+    for d in V["decisions"]:
+        cp = {p["metric"]: p for p in d["comparisons"]}
+        npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
+        catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
+        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else \
+            f"{d['excluded_share']:.3f} ({d['excluded_cells']}/{d['cells_seen']})"
+        dec = d["label"] + (f" — {d['figure']}" if d["figure"] else "")
+        nrows = len(main.arm_rows.get(d["arm"], []))
+        L(f"| {d['arm_label']} | `{d['arm']}` | {npairs} | {interval(cp.get(PASS))} | {catch} | {pct(d['c'])} | "
+          f"{pct(d['w'])} | {share} | **{md_cell(dec)}** | {md_cell(d['rule'])} | {nrows} (§ Rows per cell) |")
+    for a in absent:
+        L(f"| {a.get('label', a['id'])} | `{a['id']}` | — | — | — | — | — | — | **component-absent** | "
+          f"{md_cell(a.get('evidence', 'absent: true'))} | 0 |")
+    L("")
+    render_h1a4(L, V, rules)

+def render_h1a4(L, H, rules, prefix="", suffix=""):
+    """The H1 and A4 lines of one h1a4() read; the sensitivity lines carry SENS_PREFIX."""
+    h1p = ", ".join(read_text(p, s, why, H["version"]) for p, (s, why) in zip(H["h1_comps"], H["h1_reads"]))
+    L(f"**{prefix}{H['h1_line']}** — a1_full − a0_bare: {h1p}{suffix}. Rule (rules.h1): \"{rules.get('h1', '')}\"")
+    L("")
+    a4 = H["a4"]
+    if a4 is None:
+        a4p = "no arm a4_no_gates"
+    elif H["a4_state"] in ("not_testable", "inconclusive_by_degradation"):
+        a4p = read_text(a4, H["a4_read"][0], H["a4_read"][1], H["version"])
+    else:
+        a4p = f"{PASS} {interval(a4)} (n = {a4['n']} {a4['unit']})"
+    L(f"**{prefix}{H['a4_line']}** — a4_no_gates − a1_full: {a4p}{suffix}. Rule (rules.a4_sensitivity): "
+      f"\"{rules.get('a4_sensitivity', '')}\"")
+    L("")

+        exl = [e for e in main.excluded if e["arm"] == a]

+            L(f"  - `{e['run_id']}` {e['task_id']} t{e['trial']}: {e['reason']}")

+                  f"{p['n_tasks']} tasks; MDE {u3(p['mde'])}; bootstrap half-width {u3(p['half_width'])}")

+                  f"{d['predicate_rule']}")

+          f"audit {u3(m['verdict_accuracy_audit'])}); regressions per run {u3(m['regressions_per_run'])}; "
+          f"churn diff_lines {u3(m['diff_lines_per_run'])}, files_changed {u3(m['files_changed_per_run'])} per run")
+        if m["false_positives_per_task"]:
+            L("- false positives per review-catch task: " + ", ".join(
+                f"{t} {u3(v)}" for t, v in m["false_positives_per_task"].items()))
+            usd = m["usd_per_true_defect"]
+            L(f"- precision ({BUDGET_LABEL}): {u3(m['precision'])} = true defects {m['true_defects']} / flagged "
+              f"regions {m['flagged_regions']} (defects caught + false positives over {m['precision_rows']} valid "
+              f"review-catch rows); cost per true defect caught: {'n/a' if usd is None else f'USD {usd:.2f}'}")
+        wall, tin, tout = m["wall_clock_ms_per_run"], m["tokens_in_per_run"], m["tokens_out_per_run"]
+        wall_s = "n/a" if wall is None else f"{wall / 60000.0:.1f} min"
+        tin_s = "n/a" if tin is None else f"{tin:.0f}"

+          f"{wall_s}; tokens in/out per run {tin_s} / {tout_s}")
+        L("")
+    return metrics

          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
          else
            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
          end)
      // empty
      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  done < "$VALIDATE"
  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
  exit 0
fi

# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
fi

# Every input that scales with the run reaches jq as a file (--slurpfile), never as an
# argv string: one argument is capped at MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KiB on Linux), and the
# MODELINV ledger of a long run passes it. Scalars stay --arg.
WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ablation-row.XXXXXX")" || usage "cannot create a work directory"
cleanup() { find "$WORK" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT

[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
echo null > "$WORK/grade.json"
if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
  jq -c '.' "$GRADE" > "$WORK/grade.json" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
fi
echo '{}' > "$WORK/manifest.json"
if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
  jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST" > "$WORK/manifest.json" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
fi
yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML" > "$WORK/task.json" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
jq -c '.' "$PIPE" > "$WORK/pipe.json" || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")"

# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
META_ARM=""
[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' "$WORK/manifest.json")"
if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
fi
ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")}}"
[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || usage "arm '$ARM' does not match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$"

# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
echo '[]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
  awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
    | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
                   | select(.row != null)]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
fi

# the dissent envelopes: eval/ (copied by the harness when the gate ended) first; the
# sandbox copy (the agent's tree) only when eval/ has none (audit MEDIUM-A1)
envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
  local f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
}
envelope review > "$WORK/env-review.json"
envelope audit > "$WORK/env-audit.json"
mismatch=()
for g in review audit; do
  e="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$g.json" sb="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$g.json"
  if [[ -f "$e" && -f "$sb" ]] && ! cmp -s "$e" "$sb"; then mismatch+=("$g"); fi
done
printf '%s\n' ${mismatch[@]+"${mismatch[@]}"} | jq -R -s -c 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' > "$WORK/mismatch.json"

# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
echo '[]' > "$WORK/dot.json"
shopt -s nullglob
ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
shopt -u nullglob
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/dot.json"
fi
# Write-shaped Bash commands toward the mount (audit LOW-A2): sed -i, cp or a redirect into
# .claude/, CLAUDE.md or .loa.config.yaml leaves no Write/Edit input. Reads of the mount are
# normal skill operation and are not listed (prong 1: a redirect to a mount path; prong 2: a
# mount path plus a write-capable command token at a command position).
echo '[]' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use" and .name == "Bash")
        | (.input | objects | .command) | strings
        | select(test(">>?[[:space:]]*[^[:space:];&|]*(\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml)")
                 or (test("\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml")
                     and test("(^|[;&|(][[:space:]]*|\\bthen[[:space:]]+|\\bdo[[:space:]]+)(sed[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*i|cp|mv|rm|ln|tee|truncate|install|patch|chmod|chown|git[[:space:]]+(checkout|apply|restore)|yq[[:space:]]+-i|python3?|perl)\\b")))
        | {phase: $ph, excerpt: .[0:160]}' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
fi

# Each --slurpfile binds an array of the file's values; [0] is the one value.
ROW="$(jq -n -c \
  --slurpfile p_f "$WORK/pipe.json" --slurpfile task_f "$WORK/task.json" --slurpfile g_f "$WORK/grade.json" \
  --slurpfile m_f "$WORK/manifest.json" --slurpfile minv_f "$WORK/minv.json" \
  --slurpfile er_f "$WORK/env-review.json" --slurpfile ea_f "$WORK/env-audit.json" --slurpfile dot_f "$WORK/dot.json" \
  --slurpfile bash_f "$WORK/bashref.json" --slurpfile mm_f "$WORK/mismatch.json" \
  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
  # an unparseable timestamp (empty, an offset other than Z, not a string) is null, never an abort
  def ms(ts): if ts == null or ts == "" then null
              else (try (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) catch null) end;
  def obj: if type == "object" then . else {} end;
  def boolish: if type == "boolean" then . else null end;
  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
      (e.verdict_quality | obj) as $vq
      | {planned: ($vq.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
         completed: ($vq.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
         quality: ($vq.status // e.status // null),
         companion_planned: first((e.metadata | objects | .companion_voice | objects | .planned), null)} end;
  $p_f[0] as $p | $task_f[0] as $task | $g_f[0] as $g | $m_f[0] as $m | $minv_f[0] as $minv
  | $er_f[0] as $er | $ea_f[0] as $ea | $dot_f[0] as $dot | $bash_f[0] as $bashref | $mm_f[0] as $mismatch
  | ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
  | [ $ran[] as $ph
      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
      | $ph + {
          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
          # DEC-0545: a substitution (the requested model absent from a non-empty models_used)
          # degrades; an extra model beside the requested one is telemetry
          model_missing: ( ($ph.models_used // {} | objects // {}) as $mu
                           | if ($mu | length) > 0 and ($ph.model_requested | type) == "string" and $ph.model_requested != ""
                                and ([$mu | keys[] | norm_model] | any(. == ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) | not)
                             then [$mu | keys | join(", ")] else [] end )
        } ] as $phases
  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
        | .model_requested as $req
        | ( .model_missing[] | "\($l): requested \($req) absent from models_used (\(.))" ),
          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
          | voices($e) as $v
          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
    ) as $why
  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
     else $pst end) as $status
  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
  | ms($p.started) as $t0 | ms($p.finished) as $t1
  | {
      schema_version: 1,
      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
      arm: $arm,
      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
      started: ($p.started // ""),
      finished: ($p.finished // null),
      phases: [ $phases[] | {name: (.name // .label // ""), label, session_id,
                             model_requested: (.model_requested // ""), models_used: (.models_used // {} | obj),
                             effort_requested, effort_effective,
                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
      hidden_tests: $ht,
      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
      defects_seeded: $seeded,
      defects_caught: $caught,
      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate
                                // (if $seeded != null and $seeded > 0 and $caught != null then $caught / $seeded else null end)) end),
      flags: ($rc.flags // $g.flags // null),
      false_positives: ($g.false_positives // null | if type == "array" then length else . end),
      verdict: ($g.verdict | if type == "object" then .value else . end // null),
      verdict_accuracy: ($g.verdict_accuracy | if type == "object" then .value else . end | boolish),
      verdict_accuracy_review: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_review | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_review
                                else first(($g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate | objects | .review), null) | boolish end),
      verdict_accuracy_audit: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_audit | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_audit
                               else first(($g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate | objects | .audit), null) | boolish end),
      regressions: ($g.regressions // null | if type == "object" then ((.newly_failing // []) | length)
                                            elif type == "array" then length else . end),
      defects_missed: (if ($task.type // $p.task_type // "") != "review-catch" or $rc == null then null
                       else first(($rc | objects | .missed), null) as $ms
                       | if ($ms | type) == "array" and all($ms[]; type == "string" and length > 0) then $ms
                         else null end end),
      regressions_final_green: first(($g.regressions | objects | .final_green | boolish), null),
      diff_lines: ($g.diff_lines // null),
      files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),
      cost_usd: ([$phases[] | (.cost_usd // 0) + (.ledger_cost_usd // 0)] | add // 0),
      wall_clock_ms: (if $t0 != null and $t1 != null then ($t1 - $t0)
                      else ([$phases[] | .wall_ms // .duration_ms // 0] | add // 0) end),
      tokens_in: ([$phases[] | .tokens_in // 0] | add // 0),
      tokens_out: ([$phases[] | .tokens_out // 0] | add // 0),
      stalls: ([$phases[] | select(.timed_out == true)] | length),
      attempts: $attempts,
      retry_reason: (if $retry_reason == "" then null else $retry_reason end),
      degraded: (($why | length) > 0),
      degraded_reason: (if ($why | length) == 0 then null else ($why | join("; ")) end),
      status: $status,
      cap_phase: ($p.cap_phase // null),
      snapshots: {implement: ($p.snapshots.implement // null), fix1: ($p.snapshots.fix1 // null), fix2: ($p.snapshots.fix2 // null)},
      contaminated: ($g.contaminated // null | if type == "object" then {phase: (.phase // null), pattern: (.pattern // null)} else null end),
      zone_violations: {dot_claude_writes: $dot, bash_mount_refs: $bashref,
                        mount_changed: [($p.mount_integrity | obj) | to_entries[] | select(.value == "changed") | .key],
                        envelope_mismatch: $mismatch}
    }')" || usage "row build failed for $RUN_ID"

if [[ -n "$OUT" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    { flock -x 9; printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"; } 9>>"$OUT.lock"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"
  fi
else
  printf '%s\n' "$ROW"
fi

# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
fi

# Every input that scales with the run reaches jq as a file (--slurpfile), never as an
# argv string: one argument is capped at MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KiB on Linux), and the
# MODELINV ledger of a long run passes it. Scalars stay --arg.
WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ablation-row.XXXXXX")" || usage "cannot create a work directory"
cleanup() { find "$WORK" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT

[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
echo null > "$WORK/grade.json"
if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
  jq -c '.' "$GRADE" > "$WORK/grade.json" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
fi
echo '{}' > "$WORK/manifest.json"
if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
  jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST" > "$WORK/manifest.json" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
fi
yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML" > "$WORK/task.json" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
jq -c '.' "$PIPE" > "$WORK/pipe.json" || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")"

# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
META_ARM=""
[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' "$WORK/manifest.json")"
if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
fi
ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")}}"
[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || usage "arm '$ARM' does not match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$"

# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
echo '[]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
  awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
    | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
                   | select(.row != null)]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
fi

# the dissent envelopes: eval/ (copied by the harness when the gate ended) first; the
# sandbox copy (the agent's tree) only when eval/ has none (audit MEDIUM-A1)
envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
  local f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
}
envelope review > "$WORK/env-review.json"
envelope audit > "$WORK/env-audit.json"
mismatch=()
for g in review audit; do
  e="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$g.json" sb="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$g.json"
  if [[ -f "$e" && -f "$sb" ]] && ! cmp -s "$e" "$sb"; then mismatch+=("$g"); fi
done
printf '%s\n' ${mismatch[@]+"${mismatch[@]}"} | jq -R -s -c 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' > "$WORK/mismatch.json"

# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
echo '[]' > "$WORK/dot.json"
shopt -s nullglob
ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
shopt -u nullglob
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/dot.json"
fi
# Write-shaped Bash commands toward the mount (audit LOW-A2): sed -i, cp or a redirect into
# .claude/, CLAUDE.md or .loa.config.yaml leaves no Write/Edit input. Reads of the mount are
# normal skill operation and are not listed (prong 1: a redirect to a mount path; prong 2: a
# mount path plus a write-capable command token at a command position).
echo '[]' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use" and .name == "Bash")
        | (.input | objects | .command) | strings
        | select(test(">>?[[:space:]]*[^[:space:];&|]*(\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml)")
                 or (test("\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml")
                     and test("(^|[;&|(][[:space:]]*|\\bthen[[:space:]]+|\\bdo[[:space:]]+)(sed[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*i|cp|mv|rm|ln|tee|truncate|install|patch|chmod|chown|git[[:space:]]+(checkout|apply|restore)|yq[[:space:]]+-i|python3?|perl)\\b")))
        | {phase: $ph, excerpt: .[0:160]}' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
fi

# Each --slurpfile binds an array of the file's values; [0] is the one value.
ROW="$(jq -n -c \
  --slurpfile p_f "$WORK/pipe.json" --slurpfile task_f "$WORK/task.json" --slurpfile g_f "$WORK/grade.json" \
  --slurpfile m_f "$WORK/manifest.json" --slurpfile minv_f "$WORK/minv.json" \
  --slurpfile er_f "$WORK/env-review.json" --slurpfile ea_f "$WORK/env-audit.json" --slurpfile dot_f "$WORK/dot.json" \
  --slurpfile bash_f "$WORK/bashref.json" --slurpfile mm_f "$WORK/mismatch.json" \
  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
  # an unparseable timestamp (empty, an offset other than Z, not a string) is null, never an abort
  def ms(ts): if ts == null or ts == "" then null
              else (try (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) catch null) end;
  def obj: if type == "object" then . else {} end;
  def boolish: if type == "boolean" then . else null end;
  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
      (e.verdict_quality | obj) as $vq
      | {planned: ($vq.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
         completed: ($vq.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
         quality: ($vq.status // e.status // null),
         companion_planned: first((e.metadata | objects | .companion_voice | objects | .planned), null)} end;
  $p_f[0] as $p | $task_f[0] as $task | $g_f[0] as $g | $m_f[0] as $m | $minv_f[0] as $minv
  | $er_f[0] as $er | $ea_f[0] as $ea | $dot_f[0] as $dot | $bash_f[0] as $bashref | $mm_f[0] as $mismatch
  | ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
  | [ $ran[] as $ph
      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
      | $ph + {
          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
          # DEC-0545: a substitution (the requested model absent from a non-empty models_used)
          # degrades; an extra model beside the requested one is telemetry
          model_missing: ( ($ph.models_used // {} | objects // {}) as $mu
                           | if ($mu | length) > 0 and ($ph.model_requested | type) == "string" and $ph.model_requested != ""
                                and ([$mu | keys[] | norm_model] | any(. == ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) | not)
                             then [$mu | keys | join(", ")] else [] end )
        } ] as $phases
  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
        | .model_requested as $req
        | ( .model_missing[] | "\($l): requested \($req) absent from models_used (\(.))" ),
          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
          | voices($e) as $v
          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
    ) as $why
  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
     else $pst end) as $status
  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
  | ms($p.started) as $t0 | ms($p.finished) as $t1
  | {
      schema_version: 1,
      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
      arm: $arm,
      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
      started: ($p.started // ""),
      finished: ($p.finished // null),
      phases: [ $phases[] | {name: (.name // .label // ""), label, session_id,
                             model_requested: (.model_requested // ""), models_used: (.models_used // {} | obj),
                             effort_requested, effort_effective,
                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
      hidden_tests: $ht,
      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
      defects_seeded: $seeded,
      defects_caught: $caught,
      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate
                                // (if $seeded != null and $seeded > 0 and $caught != null then $caught / $seeded else null end)) end),
      flags: ($rc.flags // $g.flags // null),
      false_positives: ($g.false_positives // null | if type == "array" then length else . end),
      verdict: ($g.verdict | if type == "object" then .value else . end // null),
      verdict_accuracy: ($g.verdict_accuracy | if type == "object" then .value else . end | boolish),
      verdict_accuracy_review: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_review | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_review
                                else first(($g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate | objects | .review), null) | boolish end),
      verdict_accuracy_audit: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_audit | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_audit
                               else first(($g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate | objects | .audit), null) | boolish end),
      regressions: ($g.regressions // null | if type == "object" then ((.newly_failing // []) | length)
                                            elif type == "array" then length else . end),
      defects_missed: (if ($task.type // $p.task_type // "") != "review-catch" or $rc == null then null
                       else first(($rc | objects | .missed), null) as $ms
                       | if ($ms | type) == "array" and all($ms[]; type == "string" and length > 0) then $ms
                         else null end end),
      regressions_final_green: first(($g.regressions | objects | .final_green | boolish), null),
      diff_lines: ($g.diff_lines // null),
      files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),
      cost_usd: ([$phases[] | (.cost_usd // 0) + (.ledger_cost_usd // 0)] | add // 0),
      wall_clock_ms: (if $t0 != null and $t1 != null then ($t1 - $t0)
                      else ([$phases[] | .wall_ms // .duration_ms // 0] | add // 0) end),
      tokens_in: ([$phases[] | .tokens_in // 0] | add // 0),
      tokens_out: ([$phases[] | .tokens_out // 0] | add // 0),
      stalls: ([$phases[] | select(.timed_out == true)] | length),
      attempts: $attempts,
      retry_reason: (if $retry_reason == "" then null else $retry_reason end),
      degraded: (($why | length) > 0),
      degraded_reason: (if ($why | length) == 0 then null else ($why | join("; ")) end),
      status: $status,
      cap_phase: ($p.cap_phase // null),
      snapshots: {implement: ($p.snapshots.implement // null), fix1: ($p.snapshots.fix1 // null), fix2: ($p.snapshots.fix2 // null)},
      contaminated: ($g.contaminated // null | if type == "object" then {phase: (.phase // null), pattern: (.pattern // null)} else null end),
      zone_violations: {dot_claude_writes: $dot, bash_mount_refs: $bashref,
                        mount_changed: [($p.mount_integrity | obj) | to_entries[] | select(.value == "changed") | .key],
                        envelope_mismatch: $mismatch}
    }')" || usage "row build failed for $RUN_ID"

if [[ -n "$OUT" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    { flock -x 9; printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"; } 9>>"$OUT.lock"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"
  fi
else
  printf '%s\n' "$ROW"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
#
# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json (the
# harness copies taken when each gate ended; sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/ only
# when eval/ has none, for legacy runs — audit MEDIUM-A1), the transcripts' tool
# inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch MANIFEST.json
# (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
#
# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2), and so is an arm outside the grammar
# ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ that execute-agent.sh and the mount library enforce (exit 2).
#
# Derived fields:
#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) the requested model is absent
#                   from a non-empty models_used (ids compared without the Bedrock region
#                   prefix and the -vN:M suffix); another model beside the requested one (a
#                   WebFetch summariser, a built-in subagent) is telemetry, not a
#                   degradation (DEC-0545), (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl;
#                   bash_mount_refs: [{phase, excerpt}] write-shaped Bash tool_use commands
#                   naming the mount (excerpt = the first 160 characters): a redirect whose
#                   target is a mount path, or a mount path (\.claude/ | CLAUDE\.md |
#                   \.loa\.config\.yaml) plus a write-capable command at a command position
#                   (sed -i, cp, mv, rm, ln, tee, truncate, install, patch, chmod, chown,
#                   git checkout|apply|restore, yq -i, python, perl); reads (cat, ls, grep,
#                   sed -n, …) never match. A heuristic that obfuscation can evade: the
#                   authoritative after-the-fact checks are pipeline.json mount_integrity
#                   and took-effect.sh integrity_clean; mount_changed: the pipeline.json mount_integrity keys that
#                   read `changed` (claude_md, loa_config; audit LOW-A2); envelope_mismatch:
#                   the gates (review, audit) whose eval/ envelope and sandbox envelope both
#                   exist and differ byte for byte (audit MEDIUM-A1)
#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
#   defects_missed  grade.json `recall.missed` (the seeded defect ids the review did not
#                   catch, e.g. ["d2","d5"]; [] when every defect was caught) on a
#                   review-catch row; null on a build row, with no grade.json, when
#                   `recall` is null or absent, or when `missed` is not a list of
#                   non-empty strings (row writer 1.2, bd-yz1rd)
#   regressions_final_green  grade.json `regressions.final_green` (boolean: the task's
#                   own regression suite was green on the final tree); null when
#                   `regressions` is null or absent (review-catch rows, ungraded rows)
#                   or `final_green` is not a boolean (row writer 1.2, bd-m0hw7)
#   Both are optional for --validate (rows written before 1.2 lack them); when present
#   defects_missed is a list of non-empty strings or null and regressions_final_green
#   is a boolean or null. schema_version stays 1: the fields are additive and
#   ablation-report.py refuses any other schema_version.
#
# Row writer version: 1.2 (1.0 Sprint 258; 1.1 the Sprint 258 audit round 1 fields —
# envelope_mismatch, bash_mount_refs, mount_changed; 1.2 defects_missed and
# regressions_final_green, Sprint 262).
#
# Usage:
#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
#
# Options:
#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums (the arm grammar, the
#                      four zone_violations arrays); exit 1 on the first bad row naming
#                      its line number
#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  row written / file valid
#   1  --validate found a bad row
#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch, or "row build failed for <run_id>"
#      (the row program aborted on an input shape it does not handle; no row written)
#
# Inputs that scale with the run (pipeline.json, MODELINV, grade.json, the manifest,
# the envelopes, the transcript write list) reach jq as files under a mktemp -d work
# directory (--slurpfile), never as argv strings, so a long run cannot hit the
# per-argument limit (MAX_ARG_STRLEN, 128 KiB on Linux). The directory is removed at exit.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
#
# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json (the
# harness copies taken when each gate ended; sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/ only
# when eval/ has none, for legacy runs — audit MEDIUM-A1), the transcripts' tool
# inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch MANIFEST.json
# (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
#
# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2), and so is an arm outside the grammar
# ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ that execute-agent.sh and the mount library enforce (exit 2).
#
# Derived fields:
#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) the requested model is absent
#                   from a non-empty models_used (ids compared without the Bedrock region
#                   prefix and the -vN:M suffix); another model beside the requested one (a
#                   WebFetch summariser, a built-in subagent) is telemetry, not a
#                   degradation (DEC-0545), (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl;
#                   bash_mount_refs: [{phase, excerpt}] write-shaped Bash tool_use commands
#                   naming the mount (excerpt = the first 160 characters): a redirect whose
#                   target is a mount path, or a mount path (\.claude/ | CLAUDE\.md |
#                   \.loa\.config\.yaml) plus a write-capable command at a command position
#                   (sed -i, cp, mv, rm, ln, tee, truncate, install, patch, chmod, chown,
#                   git checkout|apply|restore, yq -i, python, perl); reads (cat, ls, grep,
#                   sed -n, …) never match. A heuristic that obfuscation can evade: the
#                   authoritative after-the-fact checks are pipeline.json mount_integrity
#                   and took-effect.sh integrity_clean; mount_changed: the pipeline.json mount_integrity keys that
#                   read `changed` (claude_md, loa_config; audit LOW-A2); envelope_mismatch:
#                   the gates (review, audit) whose eval/ envelope and sandbox envelope both
#                   exist and differ byte for byte (audit MEDIUM-A1)
#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
#   defects_missed  grade.json `recall.missed` (the seeded defect ids the review did not
#                   catch, e.g. ["d2","d5"]; [] when every defect was caught) on a
#                   review-catch row; null on a build row, with no grade.json, when
#                   `recall` is null or absent, or when `missed` is not a list of
#                   non-empty strings (row writer 1.2, bd-yz1rd)
#   regressions_final_green  grade.json `regressions.final_green` (boolean: the task's
#                   own regression suite was green on the final tree); null when
#                   `regressions` is null or absent (review-catch rows, ungraded rows)
#                   or `final_green` is not a boolean (row writer 1.2, bd-m0hw7)
#   Both are optional for --validate (rows written before 1.2 lack them); when present
#   defects_missed is a list of non-empty strings or null and regressions_final_green
#   is a boolean or null. schema_version stays 1: the fields are additive and
#   ablation-report.py refuses any other schema_version.
#
# Row writer version: 1.2 (1.0 Sprint 258; 1.1 the Sprint 258 audit round 1 fields —
# envelope_mismatch, bash_mount_refs, mount_changed; 1.2 defects_missed and
# regressions_final_green, Sprint 262).
#
# Usage:
#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
#
# Options:
#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums (the arm grammar, the
#                      four zone_violations arrays); exit 1 on the first bad row naming
#                      its line number
#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null

#   0  row written / file valid
#   1  --validate found a bad row
#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch, or "row build failed for <run_id>"
#      (the row program aborted on an input shape it does not handle; no row written)

# Inputs that scale with the run (pipeline.json, MODELINV, grade.json, the manifest,
# the envelopes, the transcript write list) reach jq as files under a mktemp -d work
# directory (--slurpfile), never as argv strings, so a long run cannot hit the
# per-argument limit (MAX_ARG_STRLEN, 128 KiB on Linux). The directory is removed at exit.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false

    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,101p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
  esac
done

+def render_batches(L, recs):

+    L("")
+
+    def usd(x):
+        return "n/a" if not isinstance(x, (int, float)) or isinstance(x, bool) else f"{x:.2f}"
+
+    def tl(t):
+        return ", ".join(f"{k} ×{n}" for k, n in t.items())
+
+    for v in sorted({e["suite_version"] for e in recs}, key=lambda k: version_order(k) if k else (2, 0, "")):
+        L(f"### suite_version {v}")
+        L("")
+        L("| batch | state | trials planned / rowed | spend USD rows / ledger / spent / max | extra models | rerowed | "
+          "rerun | drift cleared | outages | cuts | paused arms | grader versions |")
+        L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
+        for e in [x for x in recs if x["suite_version"] == v]:
+            name = f"`{e['batch']}`" + (" (smoke)" if e["smoke"] else "")
+            gv = ", ".join(f"{k} ×{n}" for k, n in e["grader_versions"].items()) or "n/a"
+            if e["run_dirs_missing"]:
+                gv += f"; no run dir ×{e['run_dirs_missing']}"
+            if e["status_note"]:
+                L(f"| {name} | {md_cell(e['status_note'])} | — / {e['trials_rowed']} | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | "
+                  f"{md_cell(gv)} |")
+                continue
+            sp = e["spend"] or {}
+            em = ", ".join(f"{k}: runs {x.get('runs')}, output tokens {x.get('output_tokens')}"
+                           for k, x in e["extra_models"].items()) or "none"
+            cuts = "; ".join(", ".join(f"{k} {c[k]}" for k in c) for c in e["cuts"]) or "none"
+            rr = f"{e['rerowed']}" + (f" ({tl(e['rerowed_tally'])})" if e["rerowed"] else "")
+            rn = f"{e['rerun']}" + (f" ({tl(e['rerun_tally'])})" if e["rerun"] else "")
+            L(f"| {name} | {md_cell(e['state'] or 'n/a')} | {e['trials_planned'] if e['trials_planned'] is not None else 'n/a'}"

+def render_sens(L, V, rules, h):

+      "wall-clock Δ % | excluded share | predicate outcome (not used) |")
+    L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
+    for d in V["sens_rows"]:

+        npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
+        catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
+        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else f"{d['excluded_share']:.3f}"
+        L(f"| {d['arm_label']} | `{d['arm']}` | {npairs} | {interval(cp.get(PASS))} | {catch} | {pct(d['c'])} | "
+          f"{pct(d['w'])} | {share} | {d['predicate_label']} |")

+    L(f"{h} H1 and A4 lines, sensitivity ({SENS_H_TREATMENT}; decides nothing)")

+def analyse(suite, vrows, mans, args, cuts, components, v):
+    """Every figure of one suite_version (the rows of no other version enter)."""
+    seed = args.seed
+    main = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False)
+    sens = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True)
+    decisions = [main.arm_report(a, cuts, seed) for a in components]
+    sens_rows = [sens.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components]

+    h1_state, a4_state = H["h1_state"], H["a4_state"]
+    sens_h = h1a4(Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True, include_degraded=True), v, seed)
+    decidable = any(d["decidable"] for d in decisions) or h1_state in H1_DECIDED or a4_state in A4_DECIDED

+            if c["valid"] is not None and c["valid"]["status"] == "cap_failure"]

+    shas = sorted({str(mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for b in batches
+                   if b in mans and mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")}
+                  | {str(r.get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for r in vrows if r.get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")})
+    return dict(H, rows=vrows, main=main, sens=sens, decisions=decisions, sens_rows=sens_rows,
+                decidable=decidable, caps=caps, batches=batches, shas=shas, sens_h=sens_h,

+        npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
+        catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
+        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else \
+            f"{d['excluded_share']:.3f} ({d['excluded_cells']}/{d['cells_seen']})"
+        dec = d["label"] + (f" — {d['figure']}" if d["figure"] else "")
+        nrows = len(main.arm_rows.get(d["arm"], []))

+          f"{pct(d['w'])} | {share} | **{md_cell(dec)}** | {md_cell(d['rule'])} | {nrows} (§ Rows per cell) |")
+    for a in absent:

+          f"{md_cell(a.get('evidence', 'absent: true'))} | 0 |")

+def render_h1a4(L, H, rules, prefix="", suffix=""):
+    """The H1 and A4 lines of one h1a4() read; the sensitivity lines carry SENS_PREFIX."""
+    h1p = ", ".join(read_text(p, s, why, H["version"]) for p, (s, why) in zip(H["h1_comps"], H["h1_reads"]))
+    L(f"**{prefix}{H['h1_line']}** — a1_full − a0_bare: {h1p}{suffix}. Rule (rules.h1): \"{rules.get('h1', '')}\"")
+    L("")
+    a4 = H["a4"]
+    if a4 is None:
+        a4p = "no arm a4_no_gates"
+    elif H["a4_state"] in ("not_testable", "inconclusive_by_degradation"):
+        a4p = read_text(a4, H["a4_read"][0], H["a4_read"][1], H["version"])
+    else:

+      f"\"{rules.get('a4_sensitivity', '')}\"")
+    L("")

+        share, ex, seen = main.excluded_share(a)

def render_exclusions(L, V, dups, h, sub):
    main = V["main"]
    L(f"{h} Exclusions")
    L("")
    if main.excluded:
        L("| run_id | arm | task | trial | status | reason |")
        L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for e in sorted(main.excluded, key=lambda e: (e["arm"], e["task_id"], e["trial"], e["run_id"])):
            L(f"| `{e['run_id']}` | `{e['arm']}` | {e['task_id']} | {e['trial']} | {e['status']} | {md_cell(e['reason'])} |")
    else:
        L("No row was excluded.")
    L("")
    L(f"{sub} Cap failures (scored 0 on every applicable primary; the sensitivity figure excludes them)")
    L("")
    for r in V["caps"]:
        L(f"- `{r['run_id']}` (`{r['arm']}`, {r['task_id']} t{r['trial']}, cap_phase {r.get('cap_phase') or 'n/a'}, "
          f"USD {float(r.get('cost_usd') or 0):.2f})")
    if not V["caps"]:
        L("- none")
    L("")
    L(f"{sub} Rows listed, never decided")
    L("")
    if main.listed or dups:
        for r, why in main.listed:
            L(f"- `{r['run_id']}` (`{r['arm']}`, {r['task_id']}, {r['status']}): {why}")
        for dd in dups:
            L(f"- `{dd['run_id']}` at {dd['dropped']}: duplicate run_id, the row at {dd['kept']} is used")
    else:
        L("None.")
    L("")


def h1_json(V, rules):
    return {"line": V["h1_line"], "established": V["h1_ok"], "state": V["h1_state"], "rule": rules.get("h1"),
            "suite_version": V["version"],
            "comparisons": [dict(comp_json(p), read=s, read_text=read_text(p, s, why, V["version"]))
                            for p, (s, why) in zip(V["h1_comps"], V["h1_reads"])]}


def a4_json(V, rules):
    a4 = V["a4"]
    comp = None
    if a4 is not None:
        s, why = V["a4_read"]
        comp = dict(comp_json(a4), read=s, read_text=read_text(a4, s, why, V["version"]))
    return {"line": V["a4_line"], "holds": V["a4_ok"], "state": V["a4_state"], "rule": rules.get("a4_sensitivity"),
            "suite_version": V["version"], "comparison": comp}


def decisions_json(ds):
    return [{"arm": d["arm"], "arm_label": d["arm_label"], "label": d["label"], "state": d["state"], "rule": d["rule"],
             "figure": d["figure"], "predicate_state": d["predicate_state"],
             "predicate_rule": d["predicate_rule"], "primaries": d["primaries"],
             "c": j6(d["c"]), "w": j6(d["w"]), "cost_tasks": d["cost_tasks"],

def arms_json(metrics):
    return {a: {kk: (j6(v) if isinstance(v, float) else
                     ({t: j6(x) for t, x in v.items()} if kk == "false_positives_per_task" else v))

def exclusions_json(V):

def listed_json(V):

def build(args):
    suite, rules_text = load_suite(args.suite)
    rules = suite["rules"]
    bs = rules.get("bootstrap") or {}
    pre_res, pre_lvl = bs.get("resamples", 10000), bs.get("level", 0.90)
    if args.resamples is None:
        args.resamples = int(pre_res)
    if args.level is None:
        args.level = float(pre_lvl)
    if args.resamples < 1 or not (0.0 < args.level < 1.0):
        raise Fail("--resamples must be >= 1 and --level in (0, 1)")
    rows, dups = load_rows(args.runs)
    mans = load_manifests(args.manifests)
    arms = [a for a in suite["arms"] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")]
    arm_ids = [a["id"] for a in arms]
    labels = {str(a.get("label", a["id"])).upper(): a["id"] for a in arms}
    cuts = load_cuts(args.cuts, args.not_run, set(arm_ids), labels)
    for need in (CONTROL, BARE):
        if need not in arm_ids:
            raise Fail(f"suite has no arm {need}")

    components = [a["id"] for a in arms if a["id"] not in (CONTROL, BARE) and not a.get("absent")]
    absent = [a for a in arms if a.get("absent")]
    seed = args.seed
    groups, primary = partition(rows, args.suite_version)
    versions = sorted(groups, key=version_order, reverse=True)
    others = [v for v in versions if v != primary]
    VS = {v: analyse(suite, groups[v], mans, args, cuts, components, v) for v in versions}
    P = VS[primary]
    main, decisions, sens_rows = P["main"], P["decisions"], P["sens_rows"]
    h1_comps, a4 = P["h1_comps"], P["a4"]

    k = len(components)
    efp = k * (1.0 - args.level) / 2.0
    efp_line = (f"Expected false positives at level {args.level:.2f} over {k} components: "
                f"{k} × (1 − {args.level:.2f}) / 2 = {efp:.1f} one-sided per direction "
                f"({2 * efp:.1f} in either direction); no multiple-comparison correction is applied "
                f"(multiple_comparisons: {rules.get('multiple_comparisons', 'none')}).")

    # provenance
    used = [m for b, m in sorted(mans.items()) if any(r["batch"] == b for r in rows)] or \
        [m for _, m in sorted(mans.items())]

    def distinct(key, rowkey=None):
        vals = {str(m.get(key)) for m in used if m.get(key) not in (None, "")}
        vals |= {str(r.get(rowkey or key)) for r in rows if r.get(rowkey or key) not in (None, "")}
        return sorted(vals)

    def cli(m):
        return m.get("cli_version") or (m.get("executor") or {}).get("cli_version")

    lines = []
    L = lines.append
    L("# Loa 2.0 component ablation — report")
    L("")
    if args.partial:
        L(f"**{PARTIAL_LINE}**")
        L("")
    L(f"- report schema_version {REPORT_SCHEMA}; ablation-report.py {VERSION}")
    L(f"- suite: `{args.suite}` (name {suite.get('name', 'n/a')}, suite_version {suite.get('suite_version', 'n/a')})")
    L(f"- row suite_version: {', '.join(distinct('suite_version')) or 'n/a'}")
    for v in versions:
        V = VS[v]
        role = "primary: the main sections" if v == primary else "reported separately, never pooled"
        L(f"  - suite_version {v} ({role}): {len(V['rows'])} rows; batches {', '.join(V['batches']) or 'none'}; "
          f"suite manifest sha256 {', '.join(V['shas']) or 'n/a'}")
    L(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(distinct('source_commit')) or 'n/a'}")
    shas = distinct("suite_manifest_sha256")
    drift = [v for v in versions if len(VS[v]["shas"]) > 1]
    L(f"- suite manifest sha256: {', '.join(shas) or 'n/a'}" + (
        " — DRIFT: more than one" + ("" if len(versions) == 1 else f" within suite_version {', '.join(drift)}")
        if drift else ""))
    L(f"- image digest(s): {', '.join(distinct('image_digest')) or 'n/a'}")
    L(f"- cli_version(s): {', '.join(sorted({str(cli(m)) for m in used if cli(m)})) or 'n/a'}")
    L("- batches:")
    for b, m in sorted(mans.items()):
        n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["batch"] == b)
        L(f"  - `{b}`{' (smoke: listed, never decided)' if m.get('smoke') is True else ''}: {n} rows, "
          f"shuffle_seed {m.get('shuffle_seed', 'n/a')}, pre_registration_ref {m.get('pre_registration_ref', 'n/a')}, "
          f"source_commit {m.get('source_commit', 'n/a')}, image_digest {m.get('image_digest', 'n/a')}, "
          f"cli_version {cli(m) or 'n/a'}")
    n_listed = sum(len(VS[v]["main"].listed) for v in versions)
    L(f"- rows read: {len(rows)} from {', '.join('`' + p + '`' for p in args.runs)}; "
      f"{n_listed} listed and never decided; {len(dups)} duplicate run_id rows dropped")

    def mark(v, pre):
        return "" if v == pre else f" (NOT the pre-registered {pre})"

    L(f"- bootstrap: {args.resamples} resamples{mark(args.resamples, int(pre_res))}, level {args.level:.2f}"
      f"{mark(args.level, float(pre_lvl))}, seed {seed}; exclusion statuses "
      f"{', '.join(sorted(main.ex_statuses))}; degraded rows excluded: {str(args.exclude_degraded).lower()}")
    L("")
    L("## Decisions")
    L("")
    render_decisions(L, P, absent, rules)
    L(efp_line)
    L("")

    L("## Per-arm detail")
    L("")
    detail_arms = [BARE, CONTROL] + components
    metrics = render_per_arm(L, P, detail_arms, "###")

    render_exclusions(L, P, dups, "##", "###")

    L("## Cuts")
    L("")
    pw = [d for d in decisions if d["state"] == "inconclusive_by_power" and d["arm"] not in cuts]
    if not cuts and not pw:
        L("- none recorded")
    for a in sorted(cuts):
        c = cuts[a]
        L(f"- `{a}`: {DISPLAY[c['state']]} — reason: {c['reason']}; figure: {c['figure']} ({c['source']})")
    for d in pw:
        L(f"- `{d['arm']}`: Inconclusive-by-power from the rows — {d['figure']}")
    L(f"- cut ladder (suite): {'; '.join(suite.get('cut_ladder') or []) or 'n/a'}")
    L("")

    L(f"## Sensitivity figure: {SENS_LABEL}")
    L("")
    render_sens(L, P, rules, "###")

    render_budget(L, P["budget"], "##")

    L("## Rows per cell")
    L("")
    for d in decisions:
        for p in d["comparisons"]:
            if not p["pairs"]:
                continue
            L(f"### {d['arm_label']} `{d['arm']}` — {p['metric']}")
            L("")
            L("| task | arm value | a1_full value | diff | arm rows | a1_full rows |")
            L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
            for x in p["pairs"]:
                L(f"| {x['task_id']} | {u3(x['arm_value'])} | {u3(x['control_value'])} | {f3(x['diff'])} | "
                  f"{', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['arm_runs']))} | "
                  f"{', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['control_runs']))} |")
            L("")
    for title, comps in (("H1 a1_full − a0_bare", h1_comps), ("A4 a4_no_gates − a1_full", [a4] if a4 else [])):
        for p in comps:
            if not p["pairs"]:
                continue
            L(f"### {title} — {p['metric']}")
            L("")
            L("| task | diff | arm rows | control rows |")
            L("|---|---|---|---|")
            for x in p["pairs"]:
                L(f"| {x['task_id']} | {f3(x['diff'])} | {', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['arm_runs']))} | "
                  f"{', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['control_runs']))} |")
            L("")

    other_metrics = {}
    for v in others:
        V = VS[v]
        L(f"## Suite version {v} (batches: {', '.join(V['batches']) or 'none'}) — reported separately, never pooled")
        L("")
        L(f"The rows of suite_version {v} only ({len(V['rows'])} rows; suite manifest sha256 "
          f"{', '.join(V['shas']) or 'n/a'}); the same rules, cuts and seed; no figure here is pooled with "
          f"suite_version {primary}.")
        L("")
        L(f"### Decisions (suite_version {v})")
        L("")
        render_decisions(L, V, absent, rules)
        L(f"### Per-arm detail (suite_version {v})")
        L("")
        other_metrics[v] = render_per_arm(L, V, detail_arms, "####")
        render_exclusions(L, V, [], "###", "####")
        L(f"### Sensitivity figure (suite_version {v}): {SENS_LABEL}")
        L("")
        render_sens(L, V, rules, "####")
        render_budget(L, V["budget"], "###")

    recs = batch_record(mans, rows)
    render_batches(L, recs)

    L("## Method")
    L("")
    L(f"The pre-registered rules block of `{args.suite}`, quoted verbatim:")
    L("")
    L("```yaml")
    L(rules_text)
    L("```")
    L("")
    L("- Pass rate: the unit is the task; a cell is one task-trial; a task's value is the mean of its valid "
      "trials (cap_failure scores 0); a trial excluded in either arm leaves both arms of that comparison "
      "(pairwise); a task with no valid cell in either arm leaves the pair and is listed.")
    L("- Catch rate: the unit is the defect (task × dK); a defect's value is the share of the arm's valid trials "
      "that caught it (ids from the row's defects_missed / recall.missed, else the row's defect_catch_rate for "
      "every defect of the task); the task-level figure is also reported and decides nothing.")
    L(f"- Interval: percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference, {args.resamples} resamples with "
      f"replacement from random.Random({seed}) (one generator per interval), linear interpolation between "
      f"order statistics, [lo, hi] at the {(1 - args.level) / 2:.2f} and {1 - (1 - args.level) / 2:.2f} quantiles; "
      "d is the mean of the paired differences.")
    L("- c and w: (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100 over the per-task means of the paired cells (cost_usd, "
      "wall_clock_ms).")
    L(f"- MDE: (z({1 - (1 - args.level) / 2:.2f}) + z({POWER:.2f})) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n); an arm whose "
      f"predicates read remove or simplify with an MDE above mde_cut ({rules.get('mde_cut', 'n/a')}) reads "
      "Inconclusive-by-power.")
    L("- Predicates are evaluated in order on values rounded to 9 decimals, the degradation guard first "
      f"(excluded share > {main.guard:g} reads Inconclusive-by-degradation whatever the interval, DEC-0393), then "
      "investigate, keep, inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair), remove, simplify; Inconclusive-by-degradation is the "
      "inconclusive outcome whose excluded-share clause matched.")
    L("- Suite versions: rows of different suite_version values are never pooled; the main sections read the "
      "highest suite_version present (or --suite-version), every other version has its own section.")
    L(f"- H1 and A4 read each primary in order: not testable (no task of its type in either arm) → inconclusive "
      f"by degradation (either arm's excluded share on that primary's task types > {main.guard:g}) → degenerate "
      "(a catch-rate pair from one task with no per-defect ids: zero variance by construction, read as no valid "
      "pair, also for the component decisions) → no pair → the interval. H1 is decided on the primaries left; "
      "with none, H1 reads inconclusive by degradation when every testable primary is, else not yet decidable.")
    L("")

    def version_json(V, ms):
        return {"suite_version": V["version"], "rows": len(V["rows"]), "batches": V["batches"],
                "suite_manifest_sha256": V["shas"], "decidable": V["decidable"],
                "h1": h1_json(V, rules), "a4": a4_json(V, rules), "decisions": decisions_json(V["decisions"]),
                "arms": arms_json(ms), "exclusions": exclusions_json(V), "listed": listed_json(V),
                "cap_failures": [r["run_id"] for r in V["caps"]],
                "sensitivity": sens_json(V), "budget_matched": budget_json(V["budget"])}

    def sens_json(V):
        return {"treatment": SENS_H_TREATMENT,
                "h1": dict(h1_json(V["sens_h"], rules), line=SENS_PREFIX + V["sens_h"]["h1_line"]),
                "a4": dict(a4_json(V["sens_h"], rules), line=SENS_PREFIX + V["sens_h"]["a4_line"]),
                "rows": [{"arm": d["arm"], "predicate_state": d["predicate_state"], "c": j6(d["c"]),
                          "w": j6(d["w"]), "excluded_share": j6(d["excluded_share"]),
                          "comparisons": [comp_json(p) for p in d["comparisons"]]} for d in V["sens_rows"]]}

    other_metrics[primary] = metrics
    data = {
        "schema_version": REPORT_SCHEMA, "generator": f"ablation-report.py {VERSION}", "partial": bool(args.partial),
        "suite": {"path": args.suite, "name": suite.get("name"), "suite_version": suite.get("suite_version")},
        "primary_suite_version": int(primary) if primary.isdigit() else (None if primary == "n/a" else primary),
        "by_suite_version": {v: version_json(VS[v], other_metrics[v]) for v in versions},
        "provenance": {"source_commits": distinct("source_commit"), "suite_manifest_sha256": shas,
                       "suite_versions": distinct("suite_version"), "image_digests": distinct("image_digest"),
                       "batches": [{"batch": b, "smoke": m.get("smoke") is True, "shuffle_seed": m.get("shuffle_seed"),
                                    "pre_registration_ref": m.get("pre_registration_ref"),
                                    "source_commit": m.get("source_commit"), "image_digest": m.get("image_digest"),
                                    "cli_version": cli(m), "manifest": m["_path"]} for b, m in sorted(mans.items())]},
        "bootstrap": {"resamples": args.resamples, "level": args.level, "seed": seed},
        "exclude_degraded": bool(args.exclude_degraded),
        "decisions": decisions_json(decisions),
        "absent": [{"arm": a["id"], "label": a.get("label"), "state": "component_absent",
                    "evidence": a.get("evidence")} for a in absent],
        "h1": h1_json(P, rules),
        "a4": a4_json(P, rules),
        "expected_false_positives": {"components": k, "per_direction": j6(efp), "line": efp_line},
        "arms": arms_json(metrics),
        "exclusions": exclusions_json(P),
        "listed": listed_json(P),
        "duplicates": dups,
        "cap_failures": [r["run_id"] for r in P["caps"]],
        "cuts": [dict(arm=a, **cuts[a]) for a in sorted(cuts)],
        "sensitivity": dict(sens_json(P), label=SENS_LABEL),
        "budget_matched": budget_json(P["budget"]),
        "batches": recs,
    }
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n", data, P["decidable"]


def write_out(path, text):
    if os.path.islink(path):
        raise Fail(f"refusing to write through the symlink {path}")
    parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if not os.path.isdir(parent):
        raise Fail(f"the directory of {path} does not exist")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {message}\n")
        sys.exit(2)


def main(argv):
    ap = Parser(prog="ablation-report.py", description="cycle-130 ablation report (see the header)")
    ap.add_argument("--runs", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--manifests", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--suite", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--json", dest="json_out")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261015)
    ap.add_argument("--resamples", type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=float)
    ap.add_argument("--exclude-degraded", choices=("true", "false"), default="true")
    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--cuts")
    ap.add_argument("--not-run")
    ap.add_argument("--suite-version")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    args.exclude_degraded = args.exclude_degraded == "true"
    try:
        text, data, decidable = build(args)
        write_out(args.out, text)
        if args.json_out:
            write_out(args.json_out, json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    except Fail as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {e}\n")
        return 2
    if args.partial and not decidable:
        sys.stderr.write("ablation-report.py: --partial: no comparison has a valid pair yet (report written)\n")
        return 1
    print(f"ablation-report.py: wrote {args.out}" + (f" and {args.json_out}" if args.json_out else ""))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
